title: Filipino, 11 Chinese arrested in alleged Batangas scam hub
summary: NASUGBU, Batangas — Eleven Chinese nationals and a Filipino were arrested after authorities raided a suspected scam hub in Sitio Batulao, Barangay Kaylaway in this town early Thursday.
